actions.reason: C0005 has strong biological support from two distinct sources: RNA shows FDR-significant upregulation of interferon and inflammatory pathways (SMD>1), and WXS shows significant BAP1 mutation enrichment (q=0.0044). Cross-modal consistency shows moderate support (median support count=3, positive silhouettes in WSI and RNA). Although there is a site-specific confounder (CJ enrichment), the biological signal is robust and not solely explained by technical factors. No better-supported structural action or resolvable evidence gap exists.

C0002 has coherent biological support from RNA (25 significant pathways, including downregulation of immune pathways) and CNV (5 significant continuous features, all lower). Cross-modal consistency shows moderate support (median support count=2, positive WSI and RNA silhouettes). Technical confounders are not significant per-set. The biological identity is defensible with corroboration from two distinct modalities.

C0001 has strong RNA pathway enrichment (18 significant pathways, large effect sizes) but lacks significant WXS or CNV support. However, cross-modal consistency shows RNA as a driver and moderate patient support (median support count=2). Technical confounders are not significant per-set. The RNA signal is strong and coherent, and no better-supported structural action or resolvable evidence gap exists. The absence of genomic corroboration is not active contradiction, and the RNA evidence is sufficient for a defensible identity.

C0003 shows no significant biological enrichment in any modality (RNA, WXS, CNV all q near 1.0). Cross-modal consistency is driven almost entirely by CT (median silhouette=0.276) with weak or negative support from other modalities. Strong technical confounders (SIEMENS manufacturer, scanner model, kernel) are FDR-significant, indicating the set is likely defined by technical factors rather than biology. No supported structural action or resolvable evidence gap exists; Drop is appropriate.

C0004 shows no significant biological enrichment in any modality (RNA, WXS, CNV all q high). Cross-modal consistency is weak with near-zero silhouettes in most modalities and only slight WSI support. Technical confounders are not significant, but the lack of any meaningful biological signal across all modalities indicates insufficient evidence for a defensible identity. No supported structural action or resolvable evidence gap exists; Drop is appropriate.
